extra.final_summary:
Question answered: average Adelie bill length by island — Biscoe 38.375 mm, Dream 39.3857 mm, Torgersen 39.1333 mm (21 rows used).

Problems found & fixed:
1. species label variants: " Adelie" (row 1, leading space) and "Chinstarp" (row 46) normalized to allowed labels "Adelie"/"Chinstrap" — the row-1 fix was needed for the Adelie filter.
2. One exact duplicate row (row 28) removed so a penguin wasn't double-counted in the averages.

Checked but left alone: bill_length_mm all within rules range 30–60; island labels clean. Other columns (flipper_length_mm negatives, body_mass_g outliers) are outside the scope of this question and were not modified. Caveat: the duplicate-row removal and label normalization were applied to the analysis copy only.
